notes: Known-answer navigation tasks for the typescript lane. Needle-based, not line-based: bench/verify-tasks/verify.mjs resolves every needle to a unique line at the current SHA, so the manifest survives edits without stale line numbers. Paths are relative to the lane root (typescript/), not to the repository root. 'expect' blocks carry the ground truth a harness scores against; counts are minimums where marked. exact_count is exact and counts concrete, non-generic, unconditionally compiled types that satisfy the contract directly or through inheritance; abstract bases, blanket impls and cfg-gated impls are excluded. Kinds added by the fifth wave: jsx_element, jsx_factory, ambient (global namespace in a .d.ts), ambient_module (declare module), paths_alias. document_symbol tasks count every named symbol the anchored FILE declares at any nesting depth (types, members, functions, constants); each task's note enumerates that count N and states min_symbols = floor(0.75 * N), the 25% margin absorbing listings that fold container nodes. call_hierarchy tasks name callees under outgoing_includes and callers under incoming_includes; both are file+needle pairs the verifier resolves.
